facts.fact: Isabel 的父亲只存在于母亲讲述的故事里，她从未真正见过他。
facts.anchor: My father was only ever a part of my life through stories.

facts.fact: 接下来几周她与 Mr S— 多次见面，在海滩散步、去更远的地方短途冒险。
facts.anchor: We met several times over the course of the next few weeks

facts.fact: 她梦见自己穿白裙走向圣坛，而他说的不是「I do」而是「Abracadabra」。
facts.anchor: I do recall dreaming of him during those weeks, standing at the altar as I paraded down the aisle dressed in white. When I stood before him, though, he did not say ‘I do’ but ‘Abracadabra’.

facts.fact: 一个阴天下午他们去南方小镇，沿泥泞悬崖徒步看废墟城堡，后来下雨，他用毛巾帮她擦干脸。
facts.anchor: One afternoon we drove to a nearby town to the south, and hiked along muddy cliffs to see a ruined castle.

facts.fact: Mr S— 求婚时坐得笔直、面无表情，说「Why don’t we get married?」。
facts.anchor: He sat, ramrod straight as always, his face entirely devoid of emotion.

facts.fact: Mrs Hayworth 听到婚讯脸色发白，轻声问「Are you quite sure, dear?」。
facts.anchor: she blanched and asked me, in a quiet voice unlike any tone I had ever heard from her: ‘Are you quite sure, dear?’

facts.fact: Isabel 初见 S— House 时感到它巨大如城堡、带着压抑的光晕，仿佛见过邪恶并享受其中。
facts.anchor: The house, marvellous and monstruous as it was, as it is, had a halo of oppressiveness to it, as though it had seen evil and enjoyed the sight.

facts.fact: 本章以 Alexander S— 打开门走进她的房间结束。
facts.anchor: Alexander S— opened the door and walked in.
